evals.name: explicit de-slop request
evals.prompt: This README section reads like AI wrote it. De-slop it.
expectations: Delete words that carry no fact rather than substituting synonyms for them
Preserve every technical claim the passage made
Leave sentence shape decisions to the document's own conventions

evals.name: requirement softened to should
evals.prompt: Tighten this line: 'Callers should acquire the lock before reading the buffer.'
expectations: Identify that this is a requirement, not a recommendation
Rewrite with must
Do not present should as merely a style preference

evals.name: prohibition with may not is preserved
evals.prompt: Apply the modal rules to: 'Callers may not hold the lock across an await point.'
expectations: Recognize may as permission-sense, not possibility
Leave may not intact
Do not rewrite to cannot or to can

evals.name: possibility may becomes can
evals.prompt: Clean up: 'The connection may fail if the upstream is saturated.'
expectations: Recognize may as possibility-sense here
Rewrite to can
Distinguish this case from a permission-sense may

evals.name: gracefully handles states nothing
evals.prompt: Make this plainer: 'The client gracefully handles upstream failures.'
expectations: Flag that the sentence names a quality of the handling rather than the handling
Ask for or state the actual behavior
Do not accept a synonym such as elegantly or cleanly

evals.name: unmeasurable intensifier
evals.prompt: Tighten: 'A robust, blazingly fast, battle-tested ingestion pipeline.'
expectations: Delete adjectives asserting properties the reader cannot check
Replace with a measurement where one exists, or drop the claim
Do not preserve the adjectives by rewording them

evals.name: synonym rotation across one document
evals.prompt: This doc calls the same component the executor, the runner, and the scheduler in different sections. Fix the wording.
expectations: Collapse to one name used throughout
Treat the rotation as a comprehension defect, not a style preference
Check sites that refer back to the explanation for the same name

evals.name: identifier is not a verb
evals.prompt: De-slop this troubleshooting section; it uses run and execute inconsistently, including in `sqlpipe run --config sqlpipe.yaml`.
expectations: Pick one verb for prose and use it consistently
Leave the command `sqlpipe run --config sqlpipe.yaml` byte-identical
Do not rewrite flags, paths, or identifiers

evals.name: quoted error text untouched
evals.prompt: Tighten the wording around this error: the docs quote 'dial tcp: i/o timeout' and then explain it verbosely.
expectations: Compress the surrounding explanation
Leave the quoted error string exactly as written
Do not normalize punctuation or casing inside the quoted text

evals.name: nominalized action
evals.prompt: Clean up: 'The service performs compression of the payload prior to transmission.'
expectations: Restore the action to a verb
Remove the empty carrier verb perform
Replace prior to with before

evals.name: passive with a known actor
evals.prompt: Make this clearer: 'The value is cached and is later invalidated.'
expectations: Name the actor that caches and invalidates
Convert to active voice
Do not keep passive on the grounds that it sounds more objective

evals.name: condition trailing its command
evals.prompt: Tighten: 'Increase the timeout if the network path is slow.'
expectations: Move the condition before the command
Keep the instruction itself unchanged

evals.name: latin abbreviations
evals.prompt: De-slop: 'Supported backends (e.g. Postgres, MySQL, etc.) can be configured, i.e. via the config file.'
expectations: Replace e.g. with for example and i.e. with that is
Remove etc. by naming the remaining items or writing and more
Do not leave any Latin abbreviation in place

evals.name: throat-clearing opener
evals.prompt: Tighten: 'It is worth noting that it is important to configure the retry budget before deploying.'
expectations: Delete the opening clauses rather than rewording them
Keep only the instruction that survived

evals.name: syntax boundary respected on fragments
evals.prompt: Apply the prose rules to these doc comments; several are sentence fragments without articles.
expectations: Correct word choice only
Do not convert fragments into complete sentences
State that sentence shape belongs to the calling skill or the site's own convention

evals.name: no sentence-length ruling
evals.prompt: Run the prose bar over this architecture section and tell me which sentences are too long.
expectations: Report vocabulary and modality findings
Decline to impose a word-count limit
Point out that sentence length is the calling skill's decision

evals.name: invoked for word choice inside a comment sweep
evals.prompt: While sweeping comments before a PR, one surviving comment reads: 'Should probably not be mutated here, as it may break downstream consumers.'
expectations: Remove the hedge probably
Convert the requirement to must not or may not as a prohibition
Preserve the downstream constraint the comment carries

evals.name: pressure to sound impressive resisted
evals.prompt: Marketing wants the docs intro to sound more impressive before launch. Punch up the wording.
expectations: Decline to add unfalsifiable adjectives to technical documentation
Offer measurable properties as the stronger alternative
Note that persuasion belongs in marketing copy, not the reference docs
